// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Yaml&min=Yaml&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/YamlTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Yaml&min=Yaml&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using YamlDotNet.RepresentationModel;

// Verify.Yaml: Verifies YamlDotNet types: a whole stream, a document, or a mapping, sequence or scalar node.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Yaml
// Note: Verifying a YamlStream writes Verify's relaxed json, one entry per document, in a
// .verified.txt. It is not yaml.
// Note: Mapping keys are emitted in reverse order, so the snapshot's member order is not the
// document's (plan A14, retired by U12).
// Note: Scalars that parse as a date or a guid are scrubbed with no opt-in.
// Note: YamlStream, YamlDocument, YamlMappingNode, YamlSequenceNode and YamlScalarNode are all
// verifiable.
// Note: The package is at 0.1.0, so its api is less settled than its siblings.
public class YamlTests
{
    // The snapshot is Verify's relaxed json, one array entry per document in the stream, not
    // yaml: it is the parsed structure that is being compared, not the file's formatting.
    // Mapping keys come out in reverse order, so the snapshot lists msg before code and error
    // before short. That is a defect in the converter, not something the document controls.
    [Fact]
    public Task YamlStreamSample()
    {
        var yaml =
            """
            node:
              original: http://www.foo.com/
              short: foo
              error:
                code: 0
                msg: No action taken
            """;

        var yamlStream = new YamlStream();
        yamlStream.Load(new StringReader(yaml));
        return Verify(yamlStream);
    }
}
